title: SU(3) 8 tensor 8 isotypic projectors from d- and f-symbols
expression_sketch: Adjoint indices a,b,c,d,e in {1,...,8}. Clebsch-Gordan series (Wikipedia SU(3) CG; de Swart): 8 tensor 8 = 27 + 10 + 10bar + 8_s + 8_a + 1, as vector spaces dim 64 = 27+10+10+8+8+1. Orthogonal projectors on the 8x8 matrix space, with identity I(a,b;c,d) = delta(a,c)*delta(b,d): P_1(a,b;c,d) = (1/8)*delta(a,b)*delta(c,d). Symmetric octet: P_8s(a,b;c,d) = (3/5)*Sum_e d_abe*d_cde. Antisymmetric octet: P_8a(a,b;c,d) = (1/3)*Sum_e f_abe*f_cde. Remaining symmetric piece (27): P_27(a,b;c,d) = (1/2)*(delta(a,c)*delta(b,d)+delta(a,d)*delta(b,c)) - (1/8)*delta(a,b)*delta(c,d) - (3/5)*Sum_e d_abe*d_cde. Remaining antisymmetric piece (10 + 10bar): P_dec(a,b;c,d) = (1/2)*(delta(a,c)*delta(b,d)-delta(a,d)*delta(b,c)) - (1/3)*Sum_e f_abe*f_cde. Completeness: P_1+P_8s+P_8a+P_27+P_dec = I. Idempotence and orthogonality: P_X*P_Y = delta(X,Y)*P_X under double-index contraction Sum_{c,d}. Traces: Tr P_1=1, Tr P_8s=Tr P_8a=8, Tr P_27=27, Tr P_dec=20.
latent_structure: Symmetry-adapted isotypic decomposition of the adjoint tensor square of SU(3). The projectors are invariant polynomials in the d- and f-generators (plus Kronecker), reconstructing the six CG channels. Not S_3 Young on V^{tensor 3}, not spin-1/2 Clebsch, and not dummy relabeling.

function_domains.f: su(3) structure constants as in rps-t-su3-d-contractions.
function_domains.P_1: Orthogonal projector onto the singlet in 8 tensor 8.
function_domains.P_8s: Orthogonal projector onto the symmetric (d-type) octet.
function_domains.P_8a: Orthogonal projector onto the antisymmetric (f-type) octet.

nonzero_conditions.statement: The scalars 8, 5, and 3 are invertible in Q, so the displayed coefficients 1/8, 3/5, 1/3 are defined. Equivalently char not 2,3,5.
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: dimensions |8|=8, d_abe d_abe = (5/3)*8 from Haber eq. (27) at N=3; f_abe f_abe = 3*8 from Haber eq. (26)

source_provenance: A. J. Macfarlane, A. Sudbery, P. H. Weisz, Commun. Math. Phys. 11 (1968) 77 (octet tensors; d- and f-projections).
H. E. Haber, SciPost Phys. Lect. Notes 21 (2021), eqs. (26)--(27) and N=3 identities (75)--(76) implying the displayed P_27 and P_dec remainders.
J. J. de Swart, The octet model and its Clebsch-Gordan coefficients, Rev. Mod. Phys. 35 (1963) 916.
P. Cvitanovic, Group Theory, Princeton 2008 / hep-th birdtracks (Young/projector completeness in SU(3)).

derived_conditions.statement: P_8s is idempotent because Sum_{c,d} d_abe d_cde d_cdg d_fgh contracts to (5/3) d_abe d_fg e, and (3/5)*(5/3)=1.
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED

derived_conditions.statement: P_8a is idempotent because Sum_{c,d} f_abe f_cde f_cdg f_fgh contracts to 3 f_abe f_fg e, and (1/3)*3=1.
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED

derived_conditions.statement: P_1, P_8s live in the symmetric 8 vee 8 (dim 36=1+8+27); P_8a lives in the antisymmetric 8 wedge 8 (dim 28=8+10+10). Completeness on each parity sector follows from Haber (75)--(76).
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: Macfarlane et al. 1968 octet discussion; Haber N=3 characteristic identities

public_source: Wikipedia SU(3) Clebsch-Gordan 8 tensor 8 series; Macfarlane--Sudbery--Weisz 1968; Haber 2021 N=3 identities
why_not_cse_lgg: A generic 8x8 matrix of adjoint bilinears does not CSE into six irrep channels. LGG cannot invent d-type versus f-type octet projectors or the 27-plet remainder. The representation change is 8 tensor 8 -> 27+10+10bar+8_s+8_a+1.
proposer_leak_risk: Hide octet, 27-plet, decuplet, isotypic, d-type, f-type, Clebsch-Gordan. Show only the 64-component adjoint pair with unspecified numerical kernels.
notes: Algebra over Q. P_dec is the central projector onto the 10+10bar isotypic component; splitting 10 from 10bar needs an additional complex structure (epsilon-like) and is not required for the displayed orthogonal algebra. Distinct from ac-t-clebsch-half (SU(2) 1/2 tensor 1/2) and ac-t-young-s3 (S_3 on V^{tensor 3}).
